evidence_level: post-test equal-budget sensitivity analysis; not a first-open confirmatory test

QCP.checkpoint_rule: validation P feasibility first, then minimum validation Q

pairing: same train, validation, and test row identities
same initialization parameters and first-epoch batch order
same network, legal decoder, scaler, optimizer, and batch size
same maximum epochs and patience for all four routes

bootstrap.scheme: paired crossed resampling: folds within each n and global training seeds

test_access_policy: Test outcomes were known before this user-requested fairness audit. Report as post-test sensitivity evidence and never as a first-open confirmation.
failure_rule: Any nonfinite loss or prediction, support violation, infeasible reused QCP checkpoint, missing unit, pairing mismatch, or evidence hash mismatch stops analysis.
